title: Reverse Linked List
description: Given the `head` of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list's head.
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [0, 5000].
_comment: Linked lists aren't one of the generator's supported types (int, float, string, bool, and 1D/2D arrays of those only) — so this problem supplies starterCode + driverCode by hand instead of functionName/params/returnType. stdin/stdout still uses plain JSON arrays; the driver converts array <-> linked list itself.
